request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 in Tunis lost all service for a few hours yesterday evening. What happened? Now: 2026-09-03 09:00 (Thursday, Africa/Tunis). Data after this time does

parsed.title: Tunis Sites Fiber Link Failure
parsed.root_cause_summary: Fiber link loss of signal cut off service for sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002.
parsed.confidence_reason: Direct alarm evidence matches timing, and changes and maintenance were ruled out.
parsed.impact_summary: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 lost all service for four hours.

timeline.event: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on LNK-TUN-01-A.
Traffic and availability drop alert begins on S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002.
Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-TUN-001.
LINK_LOS alarm cleared on LNK-TUN-01-A and impact ended.

findings.claim: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 depend on fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A.
A critical LINK_LOS alarm occurred on LNK-TUN-01-A at 18:00.
No changes were found on the affected nodes and parents between 2026-09-02 16:00 and 2026-09-03 09:00.
No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected nodes and parents in that timeframe.

hypotheses.reason: LINK_LOS on shared transport link matches site downtime and zero availability.

dismissed_signals.reason: No changes were executed on the affected nodes or their ancestors during the incident window.
No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes or their ancestors.

recommended_actions: Inspect fiber link LNK-TUN-01-A for physical damage.
Review splice logs if maintenance occurred outside scheduled calendars.
